## Overview

Apply the existing model-owned checkpoint selection hook to RunAI ModelStreamer before reading safetensors shards. Closes #60691; extends the DefaultModelLoader optimization in #60152 without duplicating MTP naming rules.

## Performance: Qwen3.5 MTP with remote RunAI

Five alternating baseline/patch pairs ran on the same H20×8 node (TP=8), with the same checkpoint, serving arguments, resources and experiment-only quantization compatibility setting. Both images shared the same runtime base; only the RunAI loader override differed. All ten replicas reached Kubernetes Ready with zero restarts. Each passed four fixed HTTP requests (256 output tokens total) with nonzero draft acceptance.

| Metric | Baseline median (range), 5 runs | Patch median (range), 5 runs | Median improvement |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Scheduled → Kubernetes Ready | 473 s (450–511) | 360 s (326–394) | 1.31×; 113 s less |
| Draft load and weight-finalization window | 143.646 s (135.974–147.128) | 14.908 s (14.444–15.724) | 9.64×; 128.738 s less |

The five paired observations, in execution order (baseline → patch, seconds), were:

- Scheduled → Ready: 473 → 360, 477 → 394, 462 → 379, 450 → 353, 511 → 326.
- Draft window: 143.646 → 14.572, 146.395 → 14.444, 141.378 → 15.724, 135.974 → 14.908, 147.128 → 15.054.

The median improvements are separately calculated statistics, not additive stage savings. The main-load window varied considerably and showed no stable improvement. Compilation, CUDA Graph capture, and warmup remained enabled and still contribute to Ready time.

RunAI checkpoint iterator entries for the draft fell from **75,881 to 1,121**; main remained at 75,881. The code path therefore ran, but entries are not measured object-store bytes, and the draft window includes more than pure I/O. Pending time is excluded. Pod events showed cached application images in every run. One patch run had a 58 s post-scheduling, pre-main interval, retained in the total. OSS/network load was not controlled, and no independent I/O/CPU bottleneck profile was taken; this is a result for this checkpoint and environment, not a general speedup guarantee.

Initial TP=8 runs had near-zero draft acceptance in **both** arms: this checkpoint's compressed-tensors ignore entry for mtp did not match its BF16 draft subtree under this runtime's exact-name matching. The reported pairs apply the same experiment-only subtree regex to **both** arms. That configuration change is not in this PR. Across restarts, some generated continuations differed even baseline versus baseline, so the fixed requests demonstrate working serving and nonzero draft use, not numerical equivalence or a full accuracy evaluation.

The final PR commit **41eccda** was separately rebuilt and checked on GPU: Ready, zero restarts, four HTTP 200 responses, 256 output tokens, and 122/133 draft tokens accepted/proposed. This one final-image check is not mixed into the five-pair performance medians. A local RunAI Qwen3.5 smoke test also reached Ready with nonzero draft acceptance. Exact OSS bytes were not measured.

## Additional GLM-5.3 MTP check (one pair, remote RunAI)

GLM-5.3 uses the existing DeepSeek-V3.2/GLM MTP model hook; this PR adds no GLM-specific naming rule. A separate H20×8, TP=8 baseline/patch pair used the same checkpoint, node, GPUs and serving configuration, changing only the loader image. Both replicas reached Ready with zero restarts and served four HTTP 200 requests (256 output tokens total per arm) with nonzero draft acceptance.

| Metric | Baseline | Patch |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Main RunAI iterator entries | 118,629 | 118,629 |
| Draft RunAI iterator entries | 118,629 | 2,698 |
| Scheduled → Kubernetes Ready | 1,735 s | 1,079 s |
| Draft load/weight-finalization window | 705.267 s | 21.896 s |

This is one paired observation, not a repeated performance estimate. Iterator entries are not measured OSS bytes; mixed shards can still be read in full. The GLM runtime disabled global torch.compile in both arms, although graph/kernel warmup still ran, so these figures do not establish compile-on performance. Exact object-store bytes were not measured.

## Design and implementation

- **Why before the iterator:** RunAI previously prepared the complete checkpoint file list before the model's load_weights method could discard unwanted MTP tensors. A later filter cannot undo whole-file RunAI reads. The loader now obtains the existing model-owned is_unused_checkpoint_weight predicate and selects complete shards before constructing the RunAI iterator. This PR does not define new MTP naming rules or add hooks to model classes; #60152 introduced the hook for opted-in models.
- **How selection works:** Local checkpoints reuse the safetensors-header selector. For S3-compatible and other remote storage, the loader reads model.safetensors.index.json at the resolved weights URI (including model_weights overrides) and maps wanted tensor names to files before RunAI reads payloads. Mixed and unindexed shards remain included. Only selection metadata is fetched locally; weight payloads are not staged to disk.
- **Safety and distributed behavior:** Selection retains original file order. WORLD CPU ranks agree on a conservative union of required files; differing original file lists disable selection. Without a model hook, or with missing/unusable optional index metadata, the original full file list is used. If the predicate rejects every shard, the full list is retained so the model's own missing-weight error can still surface. Model-rule and tensor-read errors propagate.
- **Scope and tradeoff:** This is file-level selection, not tensor-range filtering: a mixed shard is still read in full. The extra metadata fetch and CPU collective are the cost. Earlier Hugging Face checkpoint download and runai_streamer_sharded are unchanged. Examples of existing hook-bearing MTP implementations include Qwen3.5, Qwen3-Next, Nemotron-H and DeepSeek-V3.2/GLM; unadapted models keep the full-list fallback.

This complements #60152 (Default loader) and #58016 (lazy per-tensor reads): the former owns the model rule, while this PR applies it to RunAI whole-file loading. It also complements #48023/#42060 (draft weights URI inheritance).

## Tests and CI status

At commit 41eccda, focused model-loader tests: **44 passed, 4 deselected**, including five real two-process Gloo selection/fallback cases. Separate RunAI/S3-emulator fixtures exercise actual file GETs and tensor values with Qwen3.5, Qwen3-Next and Nemotron-H predicates. Changed-file pre-commit, including mypy, passed locally. Full-repository pytest did **not** pass: CPU collection lacked soundfile. Upstream CI is **not green**: the pre-run authorization gate and Read the Docs build failed, while full Buildkite CI has not run. These are not represented as passing checks.

AI assistance was used to investigate, implement, test and prepare this change; the submitter reviewed the contents.

- [x] I used vLLM's /pr-checklist skill. (Mandatory for agents, optional for humans).
- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.
- [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity.

files.patch:
@@ -51,6 +51,28 @@ vllm serve s3://core-llm/Llama-3-8b \
     --load-format runai_streamer
 ```
 
+## Model-specific checkpoint selection
+
+For models exposing `is_unused_checkpoint_weight`, `runai_streamer` skips
+safetensors files containing only unused weights before streaming. It uses the
+same model-owned rule as the default loader, including MTP draft models with
+this hook; it does not assume a particular MTP tensor prefix.
+
+Local checkpoints are selected using safetensors headers. Object-storage
+checkpoints use `model.safetensors.index.json` from the actual weights URI
+(`model_weights` when provided). Only the index is downloaded for selection,
+not a local copy of the weights. Without a hook or a usable index, the original
+file list is retained. Files missing from the index are also retained.
+
+With distributed streaming, ranks agree on the union of required files before
+reading them. If any rank cannot filter, all files are retained. If ranks have
+different prepared file lists, selection is disabled rather than substituting
+another node's local paths.
+
+Selection is file-level: a shard containing both needed and unneeded tensors
+is still streamed in full. This does not reduce an earlier Hugging Face
+checkpoint download, and it does not change `runai_streamer_sharded`.
+
 ## Tunable parameters
 
 You can tune parameters using `--model-loader-extra-config`:

@@ -1,12 +1,16 @@
 # SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 # SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
 
+import json
 import os
 import types
+from datetime import timedelta
+from pathlib import Path
 from unittest.mock import patch
 
 import pytest
 import torch
+from safetensors.torch import save_file
 
 from vllm import SamplingParams
 from vllm.config.load import LoadConfig
@@ -150,7 +154,7 @@ def test_runai_invalid_extra_config_leaves_environ_untouched():
 )
 def test_runai_get_all_weights_resolves_source(model_config, expected_source):
     fake_self = types.SimpleNamespace(
-        _get_weights_iterator=lambda path, revision: iter(
+        _get_weights_iterator=lambda path, revision, is_unused_weight=None: iter(
             [(f"{path}@{revision}", None)]
         )
     )
@@ -164,6 +168,255 @@ def test_runai_get_all_weights_resolves_source(model_config, expected_source):
     assert weights == [(f"{expected_source}@myrev", None)]
 
 
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("selection", ["draft", "unadapted", "reject_all"])
+def test_runai_selects_shards_before_streaming(tmp_path, monkeypatch, selection):
+    """Unused shards must not reach RunAI; mixed shards retain their tensors."""
+    contents = [
+        {"main.weight": torch.tensor([1.0])},
+        {"main.bias": torch.tensor([2.0]), "draft.weight": torch.tensor([3.0])},
+        {"draft.bias": torch.tensor([4.0])},
+    ]
+    files = []
+    for i, tensors in enumerate(contents):
+        path = str(tmp_path / f"part-{i}.safetensors")
+        save_file(tensors, path)
+        files.append(path)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(rsl, "list_safetensors", lambda path: files)
+
+    opened = []
+    real_stream = rsl.runai_safetensors_weights_iterator
+
+    def stream(paths, *args):
+        opened.extend(paths)
+        yield from real_stream(paths, *args)
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(rsl, "runai_safetensors_weights_iterator", stream)
+    model = torch.nn.Module()
+    if selection == "draft":
+        model.is_unused_checkpoint_weight = lambda name: not name.startswith("draft.")
+    elif selection == "reject_all":
+        model.is_unused_checkpoint_weight = lambda name: True
+    config = types.SimpleNamespace(model=str(tmp_path), model_weights="", revision=None)
+    loaded = dict(_runai_loader({}).get_all_weights(config, model))
+
+    expected = files[1:] if selection == "draft" else files
+    assert opened == expected
+    assert set(loaded) == {
+        name
+        for tensors in (contents[1:] if selection == "draft" else contents)
+        for name in tensors
+    }
+    for name, tensor in {**contents[1], **contents[2]}.items():
+        torch.testing.assert_close(loaded[name], tensor)
+
+
+def _check_distributed_selection(rank, rendezvous, scenario):
+    torch.distributed.init_process_group(
+        "gloo",
+        init_method=rendezvous,
+        rank=rank,
+        world_size=2,
+        timeout=timedelta(seconds=30),
+    )
+    root = "s3://bucket/weights"
+    if scenario == "different_roots":
+        root += str(rank)
+    files = [root + "/main.safetensors", root + "/draft.safetensors"]
+
+    def pull_files(source, destination, **kwargs):
+        if scenario == "metadata_failure" and rank == 1:
+            raise OSError("Index temporarily unavailable")
+        (Path(destination) / "model.safetensors.index.json").write_text(
+            json.dumps(
+                {
+                    "weight_map": {
+                        "main.weight": "main.safetensors",
+                        "draft.weight": "draft.safetensors",
+                    }
+                }
+            )
+        )
+
+    try:
+        with pytest.MonkeyPatch.context() as monkeypatch:
+            monkeypatch.setattr(rsl, "list_safetensors", lambda path: files)
+            monkeypatch.setattr(rsl, "runai_pull_files", pull_files)
+            monkeypatch.setattr(
+                rsl,
+                "get_world_group",
+                lambda: types.SimpleNamespace(
+                    world_size=2, cpu_group=torch.distributed.group.WORLD
+                ),
+                raising=False,
+            )
+            # Exercise real selection and Gloo; observe the distributed stream input.
+            monkeypatch.setattr(
+                rsl,
+                "runai_safetensors_weights_iterator",
+                lambda paths, *args: iter((path, None) for path in paths),
+            )
+            model = torch.nn.Module()
+            if not (scenario == "missing_hook" and rank == 1):
+                needed = (
+                    "main." if scenario == "different_roles" and rank == 1 else "draft."
+                )
+                model.is_unused_checkpoint_weight = lambda name: (
+                    not name.startswith(needed)
+                )
+            config = types.SimpleNamespace(model=root, model_weights="", revision=None)
+            selected = [
+                path
+                for path, _ in _runai_loader({"distributed": True}).get_all_weights(
+                    config, model
+                )
+            ]
+            expected = files[1:] if scenario == "healthy" else files
+            assert selected == expected
+    finally:
+        torch.distributed.destroy_process_group()
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "scenario",
+    [
+        "healthy",
+        "metadata_failure",
+        "different_roles",
+        "missing_hook",
+        "different_roots",
+    ],
+)
+def test_distributed_runai_preserves_every_ranks_required_shards(tmp_path, scenario):
+    """All ranks must stream the same union even if one cannot filter safely."""
+    torch.multiprocessing.spawn(
+        _check_distributed_selection,
+        args=((tmp_path / "rendezvous").as_uri(), scenario),
+        nprocs=2,
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("scheme", ["s3", "gs", "az"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "index_kind", ["valid", "missing", "malformed", "unavailable", "unadapted"]
+)
+def test_runai_remote_selection_uses_actual_weight_source(
+    tmp_path, monkeypatch, scheme, index_kind
+):
+    root = f"{scheme}://bucket/weights"
+    files = [
+        root + "/main/part.safetensors",
+        root + "/draft/part.safetensors",
+        root + "/mixed.safetensors",
+        root + "/extra.safetensors",
+    ]
+    monkeypatch.setattr(rsl, "list_safetensors", lambda path: files)
+    pulled = []
+
+    def pull_files(source, destination, allow_pattern, ignore_pattern=None):
+        pulled.append((source.rstrip("/"), allow_pattern))
+        if index_kind == "unavailable":
+            # Storage SDKs do not necessarily derive errors from OSError.
+            raise Exception("Object metadata unavailable")
+        index = Path(destination) / "model.safetensors.index.json"
+        if index_kind == "valid":
+            index.write_text(
+                json.dumps(
+                    {
+                        "weight_map": {
+                            "main.weight": "main/part.safetensors",
+                            "draft.weight": "draft/part.safetensors",
+                            "main.bias": "mixed.safetensors",
+                            "draft.bias": "mixed.safetensors",
+                        }
+                    }
+                )
+            )
+        elif index_kind == "malformed":
+            index.write_text("not JSON")
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(rsl, "runai_pull_files", pull_files, raising=False)
+    opened = []
+
+    def stream(paths, *args):
+        opened.extend(paths)
+        return iter(())
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(rsl, "runai_safetensors_weights_iterator", stream)
+    model = torch.nn.Module()
+    if index_kind != "unadapted":
+        model.is_unused_checkpoint_weight = lambda name: not name.startswith("draft.")
+    # The config directory is not the checkpoint: using its index could drop
+    # tensors from an independent model_weights source.
+    (tmp_path / "model.safetensors.index.json").write_text("not the weights index")
+    config = types.SimpleNamespace(
+        model=str(tmp_path), model_weights=root, revision=None
+    )
+    list(_runai_loader({}).get_all_weights(config, model))
+
+    assert opened == (files[1:] if index_kind == "valid" else files)
+    assert pulled == (
+        []
+        if index_kind == "unadapted"
+        else [
+            (
+                root,
+                [
+                    "weights/model.safetensors.index.json",
+                    "model.safetensors.index.json",
+                ],
+            )
+        ]
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "weight_map",
+    [None, {}, [], {"draft.weight": None}, {"draft.weight": "../part.safetensors"}],
+)
+def test_runai_invalid_weight_map_keeps_original_files(monkeypatch, weight_map):
+    files = ["s3://bucket/model/part.safetensors"]
+    monkeypatch.setattr(rsl, "list_safetensors", lambda path: files)
+
+    def pull_files(source, directory, **kwargs):
+        (Path(directory) / "model.safetensors.index.json").write_text(
+            json.dumps({"weight_map": weight_map})
+        )
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(rsl, "runai_pull_files", pull_files)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
